title: Happening
description:
Something that happens to the traveller, written by a person rather than woven by the game: a dream on a particular map, somebody on the road with something to say, what the camp is doing when you arrive.

Not an `event_`. That prefix is the timeline -- what happened in history, to whom, in which epoch. A happening is what can happen to one player on a field map in the game's era, and it is true of the world in the way an NPC's line is: it would be said, or dreamt, or seen, by anybody who stood there.

The game weaves ordinary happenings itself -- tracks, weather, road company -- from what is on the tile, and those never grant knowledge. A written one wins over a woven one whenever it can happen, and may grant what a line may grant, because canon wrote it.

Canon says **where**, **on what occasion**, and **what you must already have seen**. It never says which day or how often: that is a question about play, and the game owns it, as it owns how long `renews` takes.

title.description: What the card is titled. A few words.

occasion.description: When it can find you. `night` is a night slept anywhere on the map, `arriving` the first time you reach a point of interest, `road` a step along the way, `working` the moment after gathering something. The same four the game asks about.

field_maps.description: The maps it can happen on. Empty or absent means any of them.

at.description: For `arriving` only: the points of interest whose arrival it belongs to. Each must be on one of `field_maps`.

requires.description: Discovery or word ids the traveller must have. **Observed, not understood** -- the rule a line follows: a discovery counts once its first rung past noticing is climbed. A dream is built out of what you have seen, not what you have finished.

prose.description: The passage, in the diary's voice: first person, past tense, plain. This is the happening.

choices.description: What the traveller can do about it. **Every choice is takeable and none is worse than not having been here** -- a cozy game's rule, and the game's: a choice that needs something you lack is not offered, and if every one did, the last is offered anyway.

label.description: What the button says. A verb, in the traveller's register.

line.description: What the diary records once it is taken. The outcome; there is no other.

needs.description: Discovery, word or recipe ids the traveller must hold for this to be offered at all.

grants.description: Discovery, word, field_question or recipe ids this opens -- exactly what a line's `gives` may open, through the same door. A discovery given is noticed, not climbed.

notes.description: For whoever edits canon next. Withheld from the game's bundle.
